import numpy as np, time
from scipy import sparse
from scipy.optimize import linprog
import warnings
warnings.simplefilter("ignore")
A = sparse.csr_matrix(np.array([[-4.0],[0.0],[1.0]]))
b = np.array([0.0, 196608.0, 1.0])
E = sparse.csr_matrix(np.array([[0.0]]))
d = np.array([4.0]); c = np.array([1.0])
for meth, opts in (("highs-ipm", {"presolve": False, "time_limit": 3.0}),
                   ("highs-ipm", {"time_limit": 3.0}),
                   ("highs", {"presolve": False, "time_limit": 3.0}),
                   ("highs-ds", {"presolve": False, "time_limit": 3.0})):
    t0=time.time()
    res = linprog(c, A_ub=A, b_ub=b, A_eq=E, b_eq=d, bounds=(0,None), method=meth, options=opts)
    print(meth, opts, "status", res.status, "%.2fs"%(time.time()-t0), flush=True)
EOF
